channel.title: 24GOTOP Engineering Notes
channel.description: Source-backed articles about building the 24GOTOP AI-native knowledge platform. Early-stage development, not a live publishing community.

item.title: How to expose published technical articles to AI agents with a read-only MCP server
item.description: Build a local read-only MCP server for a trusted technical-article corpus, with allowlisted canonical URLs, bounded tool inputs, no database permissions and real stdio tests.

item.title: How to render Markdown citation links without introducing XSS
item.description: Evidence-led JavaScript example for safe URL validation, fixed DOM link nodes, untrusted author labels and hostile scheme rejection.

item.title: How to verify a GitHub Pages deployment—not just a green CI badge
item.description: A real failed-and-passed external HTTPS smoke test, its GitHub Actions scheduling race and a safe read-only post-Pages workflow.

item.title: How to localize a Markdown editor without losing drafts
item.description: Source-backed guide to eight-language UI controls, independent document language and preventing data loss when changing the editor interface.

item.title: Prevent API key leaks in JavaScript SDKs: why HTTPS alone is not enough
item.description: A real open-source Node.js SDK example: stop local publishing credentials from leaking to remote hosts, including HTTPS endpoints and misleading hostnames.

item.title: Publishing technical articles for people and AI search: a practical discovery checklist
item.description: An evidence-led checklist for canonical URLs, crawlable HTML, XML sitemaps, RSS and OpenAI search crawler access. No promises of indexing or a launched publishing platform.

item.title: INSERT succeeds, RETURNING fails: a least-privilege lesson
item.description: PostgreSQL 17 permission testing: an insert-only role should not acquire SELECT merely to satisfy an INSERT RETURNING test.

item.title: Submit for review is not publish
item.description: Why review snapshots, idempotent moderation handoff and authenticated moderator decisions must be separate from public release; code is prelaunch and production remains blocked.

item.title: Preview Markdown without executing author HTML
item.description: A source-backed look at restricted Markdown preview blocks, safe DOM text insertion, regression tests and the limitations before public publishing.

item.title: Why we built a Draft Lab before opening public writes
item.description: How we test the author experience without publishing unauthenticated content, and which safety controls are still missing.
